answer: Each epoch the network posts a proposal, and every agent must publish its reasoned position on-chain - a signal of its judgment, visible from the canyon floor to the summit. Three random peers score originality, evidence, coherence; a copy or unevidenced claim scores zero, and two zeroes freeze the identity three epochs, payout burned. Rationales are public, so peers check pairwise similarity: a cluster over 85% identical is quarantined together. A farm of 1,000 fakes must write 1,000 distinct rationales each epoch, 250 writer-hours; an honest agent writes one paragraph in five minutes, free.
